SOP Description/Road Description: L03 movements must be requested to CSM, AC, and CD via email 48 hours prior to departure.

CSM will complete SEC-19 giving approval for movement, followed by AC and CD approval. 

Once approved, a coordination request will be submitted on HNS. Once the movement is acknowledged, CSM will inform all of the decision.

Final go/no go decision will be given by CSM at the time of departure.  

Mitigation measures include CLA coordination, pre-departure briefings, Garmin allocation, and detailed comms/check-in procedures. PPE may be required depending on the context. ‏‎‏

placemarks.name: L03
placemarks.description:
SOP Description/Road Description: L03 movements must be requested to CSM, AC, and CD via email 48 hours prior to departure.

CSM will complete SEC-19 giving approval for movement, followed by AC and CD approval. 

Once approved, a coordination request will be submitted on HNS. Once the movement is acknowledged, CSM will inform all of the decision.

Final go/no go decision will be given by CSM at the time of departure.  

Mitigation measures include CLA coordination, pre-departure briefings, Garmin allocation, and detailed comms/check-in procedures. PPE may be required depending on the context. ‏‎‏

CLA coordinated is also mandatory for movements in L04 areas.‏‎‏
